d: Deep chocolate brown hair reaches mid-back with voluminous, curved bangs and a side part. Dark amber eyes are large with a soft, neutral expression on a youthful face with a slender build. The outfit consists of an orange short-sleeved top with white cuffs and a matching orange overskirt with white frilled edges, worn over a dark brown full-length skirt and a dark brown belt. Signature details include mechanical grey metal rigging attached to the arms and back, featuring several small antennae and dual multi-barreled cannons.
